headline: Premier League Friday: Ipswich and Forest share points in 1-1 draw
whyCareReason: Julio Enciso cancelled out Neco Williams' early strike as points were shared at Portman Road.
teaser: FINAL: Ipswich 1, Forest 1. Williams 13', Enciso 41'. Ipswich move to 10 pts, Forest to 6 pts.
story: Ipswich Town and Nottingham Forest shared the spoils in a hard-fought 1-1 draw to kick off Premier League Matchweek 8 on Friday night, 23 October, at Portman Road. Forest grabbed an early lead in the 13th minute when full-back Neco Williams drove a low shot into the bottom corner. Ipswich responded before the interval as Paraguayan forward Julio Enciso levelled with a clinical finish in the 41st minute. The point moves Ipswich into 10th position with 10 points (3-1-4), while Nottingham Forest edge out of the bottom two into 18th place on 6 points (1-3-4).
stakes: Forest earn a vital road point to move out of the bottom two while Ipswich reach double digits in points.
rivalryAngle: Friday night football under the Portman Road floodlights ends in a deserved stalemate.
funFacts: Final: Ipswich Town 1, Nottingham Forest 1 at Portman Road.
Neco Williams scored for Forest (13'); Julio Enciso equalised for Ipswich (41').
Ipswich move to 10 points in 10th place; Forest climb to 18th on 6 points.
